On 08/04114 an operator wearing non-sterile gloves placed the non-sterile components and supplies in the ISO 5 hood for producing Alprostadil/Lidocaine without disinfecting the items. The operator did not perform any sanitization of gloves and did not disinfect the new filter prior to introducing the item into the ISO 5 hood.
